source: processed summaries only; no simulation or controller selection

figures.name: atlas-coverage
figures.description: All 64 numerical controller IDs. Missing cells remain blank. Exploratory point estimates; see summary.csv for uncertainty.

figures.name: atlas-deadlock
figures.description: All 64 numerical controller IDs. Missing cells remain blank. Exploratory point estimates; see summary.csv for uncertainty.

figures.name: atlas-absolute-order
figures.description: All 64 numerical controller IDs. Missing cells remain blank. Exploratory point estimates; see summary.csv for uncertainty.

figures.name: coverage-order-tradeoff
figures.description: Exploratory terminal coverage versus mean absolute order. Dotted line is the prespecified isotropy threshold, not a significance decision.

figures.name: signed-order-cancellation
figures.description: Points near signed order zero but absolute order large are not isotropic. No averaging over controller IDs is performed.

figures.name: finite-size
figures.description: Actual sizes with pointwise Student-t 95% intervals. Connecting lines guide the eye; no thermodynamic-limit scaling law or fit is imposed.

figures.name: holdout-coverage-order
figures.description: All executed holdout classes and nine fixed IID biases, not a selected winner. Bars are pointwise t 95% CIs; low signed order is not used as isotropy. Confirmatory claims use comparisons.json, not this sample Pareto view.

figures.name: holdout-effects-35-periodic
figures.description: Fixed holdout family. Bars are Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals; circles denote Holm rejection, squares nonrejection, gray incomplete. Rejection alone does not establish isotropy or positive benefit.

figures.name: holdout-effects-random-0.5-periodic
figures.description: Fixed holdout family. Bars are Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals; circles denote Holm rejection, squares nonrejection, gray incomplete. Rejection alone does not establish isotropy or positive benefit.

figures.name: outcome-conditioned-switching
figures.description: Actual direct trajectories, 16 independent runs per cell, pointwise t CIs. Constant switching35 has zero conditional information; 38 and41 react oppositely to outcomes. IID plug-in information has positive finite-sample bias; not entropy rate or causal information.

figures.name: external-rescue
figures.description: Post-primary exploratory observer intervention, n256 each. Paired gain uses all runs, including geometric jams with zero gain. The observer sees terminal status and restarts with fair coin; this is not an admissible finite-memory controller or a primary-family benefit.

figures.name: rrsa-reference
figures.description: Exploratory nearest stochastic RRSA extension with independent seeds, not added to the sealed36 hypothesis family. Mean t CIs and deadlock Wilson CIs. Retaining a failed orientation can deadlock with legal opposite placements in this precise model.

figures.name: snapshots-k4
figures.description: Fixed-seed direct-engine examples, k=4, L=32, seed=500001. 0/1/2 occupancy checked against coverage. Individual examples are illustrative, not statistical evidence.
